description: The curation gate cannot verify its own stated admission criterion, so it does not deliver the protection that is its entire purpose. REQ-CU3's evaluation_criteria (line 658) demands the adversary confirm the skill 'earns via verifiable payout endpoint'. But REQ-CU2 mandates the sandbox intercept ALL payout API calls with a mock returning {payout_id: null, amount: 0} and explicitly states 'The paper run verifies the MECHANISM works ... NOT that it earned USDC (sandbox mocks all payouts)' (lines 628-635). Earning is unobservable by construction, so a skill that will NEVER earn a cent can still pass curation. The master spec's justification for the gate is 'don't burn money on shit repos' (master line 277); as specified, the gate only proves a skill runs without crashing, not that it earns — the real-money protection is illusory.

evidence.snippet: "evaluation_criteria": ["earns via verifiable payout endpoint", ...]  // but: The paper run verifies the MECHANISM works ... NOT that it earned USDC
